content.short: MemeTok is a scroll-to-trade mobile app where social content doubles as the trading signal.
content.description: MemeTok presents tokens in a scrolling feed where the content itself is the pitch, and trading happens inline. It is an honest reflection of how memecoin markets already work, where attention precedes price and the feed is the actual venue, though it removes what little friction stood between seeing a token and buying it.
content.meta: A scrolling feed where the content is the pitch and trading happens inline.
